data.text: [00:04.9]Before Che Guevara arrived in Cuba and got into politics, he had lived in Argentina with his family. `[00:12.2]He and a friend, Alberto, decided they wanted to travel and see South America.
[00:17.9]Anyway, at the beginning of the film, we see them preparing for their trip in Buenos Aires ... .
[00:26]So, what was most inspiring for you about this film?

[00:30.5]Well, three things I think. `[00:33.1]Firstly, I was inspired by the two main characters – they are very believable. `[00:39.1]García Bernal is brilliant as Guevara, and Rodrigo de la Serna, as his friend Alberto, is also excellent ... . `[00:48.5]Anyway, as the film goes on, I was fascinated to see how their personalities grow and change.
